meta.title: Forge: Build & Break Habits
meta.description: Prayers, Quran, screen time, quitting and every habit in between, in one app, with the people you love. For iPhone; Android is coming.
meta.androidDescription: Forge for Android is coming. Leave your email and we'll write once, on the day it's ready.

hero.eyebrow: A habit app, Muslim-first, for everyone
hero.subFaith: Prayers, Quran, screen time, quitting, and every habit in between. One app, with the people you love.
hero.subGeneral: Habits, screen time, quitting and progress. One app, with the people you love.
hero.launch: On the App Store from 11 January
hero.strip: Thirty days, one spark at a time

switch.label: Show Forge as
switch.faithNote: Faith view shows prayer times, Quran and Ramadan.
switch.generalNote: General view shows none of it. Switch any time in the app; nothing is deleted.

phone.alt: An illustration of the Forge Today screen

season.faithText: Cut down through Sha'ban. Quit on the first day of Ramadan. Forge lowers your limit a little each week and counts the money you keep.
season.generalText: Cut down first, then stop on a date you choose. Forge counts the days and the money you keep, and a slip never wipes your progress.

items.name: Build & break habits
items.line: One list for what you build, what you break and what you finish once.
b: One tap to log, a timer for time habits
Quit tools: cravings, slips that keep your history, money saved

items.name: Control screen time
items.lineFaith: Apps go quiet when it matters, including at prayer times.
items.lineGeneral: Apps go quiet when it matters: at bedtime, while you focus.
b: A plan that learns your week, then lowers your limit
Block apps until today's habits are done

items.name: Worship in one place
b: Prayers at their real times, with adhkar after each
Dhikr counter, Quran pages and a Personal Khatma
An alarm that follows Fajr every day

items.name: Mindful moments
items.line: A minute to breathe, a line to write.
b: A private journal that stays on your phone
A gentle evening check-in, if you want one

items.name: With family & friends
bFaith: A family Khatma: each person takes a juz
See who has done today. No chat, no feed
bGeneral: Shared habits with the people you choose
Every Day challenges, counted in kept days
See who has done today. No chat, no feed

items.name: Motivation that forgives
items.line: Streaks that bend, never break you.
b: Excused and paused days never cost a streak
Progress by week, never red for a miss

privacy.title: Yours, and only yours

tiles.p: Open the app and begin. No sign-up, no email.
Your habits live on your phone and in your own private iCloud.
What you use and for how long stays on the device. Always.

privacy.line: No ads. No tracking. No account needed.

pricing.title: Free to start. Premium for everything.
freeItems: 5 habits (the five prayers count as one)
premiumItems: Widgets, Watch and the Lock Screen timer
pricing.local: Prices in your local currency in the store.
pricing.foundersNote: Founders prices until 12 March 2027. Subscribers keep their price.

made.title: Made by one person
made.p: Forge is built by Belal Hammad, one founder, in English, Arabic and Turkish. No investors, no ads. Just an app that has to be good enough that you keep it.

final.title: Start with one habit tonight.
final.sub: Leave your email and we'll write once, on launch day.

waitlist.group: I want to join a family or friends group
waitlist.privacy: One email on launch day. Nothing else. Unsubscribe in one tap.
waitlist.notOpen: Sign-up opens this week. Until then, write to support@forgeyourhabit.com and we'll add you.
waitlist.bad: Enter an email address like name@example.com.

android.p: Habits, prayers, Quit with Ramadan, Progress and groups come first. Screen Time tools stay on iPhone for now.
android.later: Coming later on Android: widgets, the Fajr alarm, the journal and Health Connect.

join.icloud: Groups use iCloud, so you'll need to be signed in to iCloud.
